text:
maya: Heads-up — customer 'BrightEdge' is seeing intermittent 401s + elevated latency since last deploy (~18:02 UTC). They also reported a sudden billing jump for token usage. Escalating because compliance wants audit evidence of KMS/HSM access around the window.

lucas: Ack. Can you paste a couple of request_ids and timestamps? I'll start pulling traces and check token validation path.

maya: Request IDs: req_0a3f9c, req_0a3fa2. Approx times: 2026-11-04T18:02:14Z and 2026-11-04T18:03:01Z. Customer included this curl repro they ran:

```bash
curl -i https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-13b-quant","prompt":"token test"}'
```

maya: They say retries made it worse; billing shows many short requests back-to-back.

eric: I pulled the matching logs — two snippets below (redacted):

```
[2026-11-04T18:02:14Z] req_0a3f9c auth: token validation failed: signature mismatch
[2026-11-04T18:02:14Z] req_0a3f9c route: /v1/generate latency_ms=512 error=401
[2026-11-04T18:03:01Z] req_0a3fa2 kms: key-unseal timeout 1200ms (backend=hsm-primary)
[2026-11-04T18:03:01Z] req_0a3fa2 route: /v1/generate latency_ms=1201 error=500
```

eric: The HSM timeout looks like a transient backend issue — could cause token failures if key material wasn't available for signature verification.

ana (compliance): Quick note from compliance — for ISO mapping we need a) timestamped audit logs showing KMS key usage for the window, b) evidence of key custody access (who/what used the key), and c) retention policy mapping to the customer SLA. Please tag the control mappings (Annex A) if you can.

lucas: For repro: try a single request with a valid token against the same model on a stable region, then a looped retry to simulate client retries. I'll add a short harness:

```bash
for i in {1..10}; do
  curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
    -d '{"model":"rwd-13b-quant","prompt":"hi"}' \
    https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate
  sleep 0.2
done
```

lucas: Also adding a quick check: `vault audit log` for key_id=kp-7a2 to verify unseal calls at the timestamps. If HSM unseal is flaky we should see retries around 18:03.

maya: @ana (compliance) can you confirm which Annex A controls you want mapped? We usually reference A.8.1 (asset management) for key custody, A.10 (cryptography) for key management, and A.12 for logging/monitoring. Want formal mapping in the ticket.

ana (compliance): That mapping is what we need. Please attach the raw log exports and the retention policy doc. For ISO evidence we'll need the exported logs in an immutable format (S3 object with checksum) and the KMS HSM access log showing process identities.

eric: I exported the truncated audit lines to a protected bucket already — url: s3://redwood-evidence/iso/2026-11-04/brightedge-kms-logs-18z (access: team-compliance). I'll add a checksum and retention metadata.

deploy-bot: [deploy] rollout r2026-11-04_17:58 by lucas completed — canary -> prod (id: deploy-9876)

maya: Noting deploy time matches. Lucas, can you confirm whether the deploy included a token rotation or key metadata change?

lucas: No key rotation in that deploy. We shipped a small change to batching logic and a runtime bump. However, the runtime bump included an updated KMS client lib (v2.1.3 -> v2.1.5). That client had a longer default timeout which should help — odd that we see a timeout.

lucas: Next steps I'm taking: 1) run the repro harness against canary + prod, 2) pull HSM vendor-side diagnostics for the 18:03 window, 3) correlate request IDs to token issue times.

maya: I'm scheduling a quick war room with BrightEdge and compliance for 18:30 UTC. Can everyone from eng + compliance join?

ana (compliance): I'll be on the call. Please include the S3 export link and the checksum in the calendar invite.

eric: Added trace spans and will attach stack sampling around the auth path.

sre-bot: [alert] increased 5xx rate on /v1/generate (1m avg) — alerted 18:05 UTC

maya: Thanks all. If we confirm HSM transient, we'll open a vendor incident and produce the ISO evidence package (export + checksum + mapping doc). If it's a token issuance bug on our side, we'll need a mitigation path (temporary key fallback or rolling rollback).

lucas: I'll post preliminary findings in this thread before the call.

maya: Closing loop: call set for 18:30 UTC, owner: lucas; evidence owner: eric; compliance lead: ana (compliance).

lucas: Roger.
